description: This file defines a class `Zend_Http_UserAgent_Spam` that extends `Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice` to identify and characterize 'spam' user agents based on specific signatures. It provides methods to match user agents against signatures, retrieve the type, and define features that are characteristic of spam user agents.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Spam
classes.description: A class for detecting 'spam' user agents based on predefined signatures, extending the abstract device user agent functionality.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Compares a user agent string against known spam signatures to determine if it is spam.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of user agent, which is 'spam' for this class.

methods.name: _defineFeatures
methods.description: Defines features relevant to spam user agents, such as disabling images, iframes, frames, and javascript capabilities.
